ढ: ढ ḍh The aspirate of the preceding.
ढ (ढः) 1. m. A large drum; a dog; his tail; sound; a serpent.
ढक्क: ढक्क (क्कः) 1. m. A city or district, Dhacca; covering. f. A large or double drum, a dhāk.
ढालिन्: ढालिन् (ली) 5. m. A warrior armed with a shield; shield-bearer.
ढोल: ढोल (लः) 1. m. A dhol or large drum.
ढौक: ढौक (-ङ) ढौकते 1. a. To go or move.
